notes.title: Update on Steamdeck and Controller Support
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276411/2c3749131afb5911b23437123932f19c9daef341.png"]
Hello Islet Defenders! 🏝️

We hope you're all having a wonderful day, protecting the kingdom and holding the castle!

We wanted to share that we’re currently working on making Islets Defense run smoothly on the Steam Deck, and alongside that, we're adding full controller support! 🎮

Now, while this might sound like a simple task, it’s actually a bit tricky. Our game has a lot of mouse interactions that don’t easily translate to a controller, like hovering over currencies to read their descriptions, or placing buildings on a big grid. And since we’re just a team of three, we want to take our time and do it right, instead of dropping in a clunky “virtual mouse” solution.

Now that the big round of launch bugfixes is behind us, we’ll be shifting full focus to this task. Our current goal is to wrap it up by late July or early August, but we’ll keep you posted if that changes!

That’s it for this short dev update, we hope you’re all enjoying your time defending your tiny islands. And hey, don’t forget to join our Discord to share your scores and chat with other defenders! It’s been super fun seeing a bit of friendly competition spark up there. 🔥

Thanks so much for reading, and have a great day!

— Matheus Cunegato

MiniGoof

notes.title: Patch v1.1.0 – Balance, QoL, and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
What's up, Defenders! Today we are releasing version 1.1.0 of Islets Defense. 

Below you can check everything that was changed on this update:



⚖️ BALANCE

(Hardcore 1-1): Slightly easier now. While the stage was aligned with our expectations for Hardcore mode, its solution felt too narrow, with very few viable paths. We've tweaked it to reduce early frustration and better match the difficulty curve of other Forest stages.

(Sea Stages): Overall a bit easier. When gathering food using a Fishing Market, tiles with fish now yield +5 food instead of +3. While not all players noticed this bonus, fish tend to appear where players naturally place markets — so this change should make food management smoother. We also adjusted some fish spawn points in stage 3-1 to make them more accessible.

(Regular and Hardcore 3-3): These stages are now easier. They were a bit too challenging compared to the rest of the curve. The improved fish gathering also helps here, but we’ve made additional tweaks to ease the overall experience. 

 🎮 QUALITY OF LIFE 

When you try to build or upgrade something but lack resources, the red warning icon now shows exactly how much of each resource you're missing — no need to open the resource window anymore.  

🛠️ FIXES  

(Stage 2-1): Fixed flickering enemy on the right side during the shooting minigame.  

Fixed a bug where defeating the last enemy with a spike could cause the game to soft-lock.  

Fixed a rare soft-lock when morphing a tile and interacting with the level UI at the same time.  

Fixed an issue that prevented reading the thermometer tooltip in Snow stages while any interface (like upgrades or morph) was open.  

Fixed minor text issues in French, Chinese, and Brazilian Portuguese.  

Fixed a visual bug where the Harvest Tree preview showed a wheat tile on Desert stages instead of a cactus. 

Fixed a very specific bug that could open a black hole on Sea stages (yes, really).  

Fixed an issue where some enemies weren’t dying even after reaching 0 HP.
